title: Paris-based Pivot, which develops AI tools for procurement and financial workflows, raised a $40M Series B co-led by Forestay Capital and Notion Capital (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: Paris-based Pivot, which develops AI tools for procurement and financial workflows, raised a $40M Series B co-led by Forestay Capital and Notion Capital — With new funding, Pivot plans to expand its AI-powered procurement and finance platform, accelerate development of agentic AI capabilities …
